planets.name: TOI-1136 g
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1136 with a 39.5-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: TOI-1136 g was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 6 planets known around TOI-1136. Its orbit and size follow Dai et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
